title: A Paired Bead and Magnet Array for Molding Microwells with Variable Concave Geometries
protocol: Prepare two 50 mm x 50 mm aluminum plates.
Form a 30 x 30 through-hole array on one plate with Φ550-µm holes, spaced 1 mm apart.
Form a 30 x 30 array of Φ750-µm through-holes on the second plate using the same procedure.
Attach the two plates together using sticky tape and form Φ3 mm alignment holes at each corner.
Soak the aluminum plates in 15% sulfuric acid for 12 hours to clean their surfaces.
Form a 30 x 30 array of 1 x 1 x 1 mm neodymium magnets with opposite polarity neighbors.
Attach a 30 x 30 mm aluminum plate to the bottom of the magnet array using double-sided tape.
Align and stack the two aluminum plates using the prepared alignment holes at the four corners of each plate.
Insert M3 bolts into the alignment holes to lock the two plates together.
Secure the bolts with nuts.
Stack the aluminum plate assembly on the prepared magnet array, aligning the array of magnets and the array of through holes in the aluminum plate during stacking.
Fix the position of the magnet array using a sticky tape.
Place sufficient number of Φ600 mm SUJ2 steel beads on the plate assembly.
Manipulate the beads with an acryl (or non-metallic) plate to trap one bead in each hole while removing excess beads.
Carefully remove the top plate to avoid unwanted scattering and dislocation of the trapped beads.
Move the concave microwell mold, produced in steps 2.1 to 2.5, to a Petri dish.
Mix polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) monomer and curing agent according to the manufacturer's instructions with a PDMS monomer:curing agent ratio of 10:1.
De-gas the PDMS mixture by using a desiccator and vacuum pump to remove any bubbles trapped in the PDMS mixture.
Pour the PDMS mixture into the concave microwell mold.
De-gas the PDMS mixture again using the same procedure.
Bake the PDMS mixture at 80 °C for 2 hours.
Remove the cured PDMS substrate from the mold.
Spray methanol using a washing bottle to detach the PDMS substrate from the mold.
Use a Φ15 mm x 2 mm magnet to remove trapped steel beads from the PDMS substrate.
Cut the concave microwell-patterned PDMS substrate using a Φ14 mm biopsy punch.
Sterilize the resulting Φ14 mm PDMS substrate in an autoclave at 121 °C and 15 psi.
Place the sterilized PDMS substrate into a 24-well plate.
Coat the entire PDMS substrate with 4% (w/v) pluronic F-127 solution overnight.
Remove any air bubbles entrapped in the concave microwells by pipetting or using an ultrasonic cleaner.
Flush the F-127 solution three times with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Seed 1 mL of cell-medium containing 2 x 10^6 cells on the PDMS substrate.
Aspirate 1 mL of medium using a 1000 µL pipette to remove excess cells not trapped in microwells.
Incubate the cells at 36.5 °C, humidity greater than 95%, and 5% CO2 conditions.
